title: Grateful Dead Live at Deer Creek Music Center on 1989-07-15
source: Recorded & Transfered By: Robert Mullen; Source: Master Audience Cassettes recorded with 2 sets of mics input to a 4 channel mixer down to 2 channels into the recorder. The 4 mics were mounted on a stand 8' in height. Located in the designated "taper" section. Equipment/Lineage:  2 DAK 5245 Microphones and 2 Realistic PZM Mics(Mounted on 1'x 1'x 3/8" plexiglass)>Realistic 4 Channel Mixer>Sony D6C Portable Stereo Cassette Recorder> Master Cassettes(Sony UX-Pro-90's)>Yamaha Natural Sound Stereo Cassette Deck K-902>SigmaTel Audio Sound Card/CD Wave Editor(tracking)>Traders Little Helper(flac level 8)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix audience mix captures a solid show highlighted by Jerry‑Brent interplay and a special setlist order.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the audio, calling it "wow" and praising the audience‑sound matrix capture. The performance itself is described as amazing, though not groundbreaking, with a notable interaction between Jerry Garcia and Brent Mydland and an unusually ordered setlist that adds interest despite the lack of specific song highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised as amazing (≈4.5/5) and recording receives a perfect score; weighted average yields ~4.6 stars. Only two reviews, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight crisp, impressive audience‑sound matrix mix with “wow” level sound quality; no reported dropouts or muffling.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer notes a somewhat special song order that adds uniqueness to the set, though overall the show is not called exceptional.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice interaction with Brent noted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Keys: Interaction with Jerry highlighted as a positive element.
